correctness.rationale: After a=1 normalization greedy absolute load difference g_t satisfies g_t=|g_(t-1)-w_t| and remains in {0,1,2}. Any competitor h_t has matching parity. Its only strictly cheaper round is (g_t,h_t)=(2,0), forcing w_t=2,g_(t-1)=0,h_(t-1)=2, so the preceding cost excess +2 cancels. The charging pairs are disjoint (a negative time has greedy g=2, a charged predecessor g=0); all other costs are >=greedy. Works for each finite prefix including arbitrary tie-breaking. Direct alternative allocations give exact gaps 6/5,6/4,5/3 and three-item minimality. Independent DP covered all 2-agent words in {1,2} length<=8, all 3-agent ternary-duration words length<=3, and the witnesses.
